F1: The factory reuses its pool after strategy closure shuts down its queues and workers, so later submissions can be marked complete without processing.
F2: Shutdown stops commits before workers and makes workers exit after their current item, abandoning queued work and preventing a final commit.
F3: Each worker queue is unbounded and submissions do not apply backpressure, allowing queued work to grow without limit.
F4: Worker and submission exception paths mark offsets complete, allowing failed messages to become committable.
F5: The test can assert before the one-second commit cycle runs, and factory shutdown does not stop the strategy’s commit thread.
